notes: NEEDS RULING: «قُلْتُ وَ كَذَلِكَ يَجْرِي فِي اَلرِّضَاعِ» is a first-person speaker with no name; the questioner's transmission is implicit (rule 11), so no link is written for him
The three co-transmitters «أبي بصير وأبي العباس وعبيد بن زرارة» meet at the Imam, who is named inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (ruling 2)
«وَ ذَكَرَ أَهْلَ هَذِهِ اَلْآيَةِ» quotes the Quran; the quotations are not transmitters
